userId.description: Target user ObjectId as hex string

notificationType.description: EmailNotificationType enum value — SUBSCRIPTION_WELCOME | SUBSCRIPTION_UPDATED | SUBSCRIPTION_RENEWAL | USER_ADDED

languageCode.description: ISO 639-1 language code (en, fr, de, es, it, nl, pt)

status.description: PendingEmailStatus enum value — PENDING | PROCESSING | SENT | FAILED

payload.description: Optional extra context as key-value pairs

attempts.description: Number of send attempts made so far

maxAttempts.description: Maximum allowed attempts before the record is permanently marked FAILED

lastError.description: Truncated error message from the most recent failed attempt

processedAt.description: Timestamp of the final SENT or FAILED state transition

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the notification was enqueued

lastUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent document update
